notes: Grok agent frontmatter model fields and ~/.grok/config.toml [subagents.models] must stay in sync with this file. NaN endpoints are registered in ~/.grok/config.toml (user-level). Quote dotted keys as [model."qwen3.6"]. See gauntlet/README.md.

orchestrator_deepseek.constraint: Overflow pickup only. Same loop as orchestrator. Critic independence is versus the builder, not this agent. Keep timing output separated by exact model ID and role; never combine current Flash with the 0731 snapshot.

critic.constraint: Never use the same model that implemented the candidate under review. If 0731 is unavailable or out of allowance, spawn critic-flash as a distinct agent type; do not override critic's model in place.

critic_flash.constraint: DeepSeek fallback critic. Same review contract as critic. Never use if the builder model is DeepSeek/current Flash.

integration_reviewer.constraint: Prefer DeepSeek. If 0731 is unavailable or out of allowance, spawn integration-reviewer-flash as a distinct agent type. Otherwise use a NaN model different from the builder under review.

integration_reviewer_flash.constraint: DeepSeek fallback integration reviewer. Same integration contract as integration-reviewer. Must differ from the builder under review.

git_committer.constraint: Bookkeeping only. Never inherit grok-4.6. Never implement or review.

evidence_auditor.constraint: Bounded semantic audit only after deterministic REVIEW_REQUIRED. Never judges overall reference-bar quality and never accepts an objective.

grok_uses: orchestration until SuperGrok weekly usage hits 89%
